summary.text:
We need implement FB_Task in ST. Let's design.

Need states IDLE, EXTEND, CLAMP, RELEASE, RETRACT, DONE. Could use enum DUT.

Requirements: Stop or Reset immediately returns IDLE and clears all outputs same scan. At most one transition. Start accepted IDLE only if RetractDone home. outputs post-transition state: e.g. q IDLE, Start & RetractDone -> q=EXTEND, then Extend TRUE same scan.

Test handshake step 0: Start true RetractDone false -> no transition, Busy false. Step1 RetractDone true -> Extend true Busy true.

single_transition step0 with all true: IDLE Start RetractDone -> EXTEND, Extend true. one transition only. step1 q EXTEND ExtendDone -> CLAMP, clamp true. step2 -> RELEASE. step3 Stop -> idle.

Need define DUT enum e.g. E_TaskState : (IDLE, EXTEND, CLAMP, RELEASE, RETRACT, DONE); INT maybe.

Declaration:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task
VAR_INPUT...
VAR_OUTPUT...
VAR
  State : E_TaskState := E_TaskState.IDLE;
END_VAR

Implementation priority:
Extend := FALSE; ... Busy FALSE; Done FALSE;
IF Stop OR Reset THEN
  State := E_TaskState.IDLE;
ELSE
  CASE State OF
    E_TaskState.IDLE:
      IF Start AND RetractDone THEN
        State := E_TaskState.EXTEND;
      END_IF
    E_TaskState.EXTEND:
      IF ExtendDone THEN State := E_TaskState.CLAMP; END_IF
...
  END_CASE
END_IF
// outputs based on updated State
CASE State OF
 EXTEND: Extend := TRUE; Busy := TRUE;
...
 DONE: Done := TRUE;
END_CASE

Potential issue Stop or Reset: State IDLE, outputs false. Good.
DONE holds until reset/stop. Start ignored in DONE.

At most one transition: CASE sets one.

One nuance: Priority Stop/Reset overrides. fine.

"Each of Extend, Clamp, Release and Retract is TRUE exactly in its corresponding post-transition state." Outputs computed after state transition. yes.

Need maybe retain output from previous if no transition? For action states, outputs stay true because State remains. Good.

Could use enum from DUT. supporting object name E_TaskState kind DUT declaration "TYPE E_TaskState : (IDLE, EXTEND, CLAMP, RELEASE, RETRACT, DONE); END_TYPE" implementation "".

Need exact interface types.

Let's compile.
